Document: - 1. If no specialists in a necessary field are present during the shift, your character may acquire the required skills. For example, a captain who is alone on the station may build and start the AME so that the station's power supply can operate normally. - 2. Stations contain many caches and secret locations whose whereabouts ordinary crew members cannot know; antagonists are an exception. You may discover such places through a lucky coincidence or by being observant while exploring the station. However, if you run off to "investigate" a wall without any logical justification, be prepared for a conversation with the administration.
